patterns.message: components/** cannot import from mails/, scripts/, catalog/, or @hackersandwizards/mail/(mails|render). Pass composed content or data in as props from mails/, and keep shared tokens and helpers in components/ (such as components/theme.ts). Do not silence with oxlint-disable.

mails/** cannot import from scripts/, catalog/, or @hackersandwizards/mail/render. Keep mails/ as pure compositions over components/, move shared helpers or types into components/ or mails/, and leave rendering or preview logic in scripts/render.ts or catalog/. Do not silence with oxlint-disable.
